verdict.rationale: Requesty has no first-party SDK of its own. Instead it is an OpenAI-compatible gateway: you point the official OpenAI SDK's base_url at router.requesty.ai, with "no SDK changes, no new client to learn". Anthropic tooling such as Claude Code connects through base-URL and auth-token environment variables. Developers can build against official provider SDKs, but Requesty-specific features have no typed SDK surface, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: first-party Requesty SDKs, typed support for gateway-specific features (policies, prompt_id, MCP), a published OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration.
